title: Planar kernel: single-pass arrangement merges non-adjacent same-color bands across multiple parallel dividers (latent, product-unreachable)
description: FIXED by task 1322 (P4 eraser). Root cause: Arrangement.insertEdge (arrangement.ts) scanned ALL even-indexed half-edges for intersections against the new edge INCLUDING ones that an earlier splitExistingEdge had RETIRED (origin=-1, left in the array to preserve even/odd twin pairing). A retired edge's stale geometry produced SPURIOUS split params that corrupted the topology when a later parallel divider crossed the same region -> the stray bridge edge (euler=-1) that fused non-adjacent same-color bands. FIX: one guard 'if (e.origin < 0) continue;' in the intersection scan. Now a same-color rect crossed by N parallel full-crossing dividers yields N+1 equal faces, euler=2, area conserved. Regression tests added in planar-adversarial.test.ts ('task 1326' describe: 2 dividers->3 faces, 3 dividers->4 faces). All P0-P3 suites + oracle cases 1-6 unchanged (diff=0/220000); the fix is a pure improvement. Committed with task 1322.
